name: Terraform
description: Code intelligence for Terraform and Terraform variables files.
about: In Gode’s editor, you can complete code, see errors and warnings as you type, inspect hover information, go to definitions, find references and rename symbols in Terraform files. The language server starts when a Terraform file opens in a project and stops when none are open. It uses the Terraform CLI on your PATH for validation when available. Completion and navigation also work without it.
